  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `_safe_gh_jq` statuses call uses `2>/dev/null`, so when the GitHub API call fails for a reason other than authorization (repository not found, server error, rate limit), the error output is thrown away and the function continues with an empty or unsuccessful result.
  WHY: If `gh_retry` finally fails, the function may treat it as a skippable condition (`status_read_failed`) when it might have been better to propagate or log the error. The reviewer said this may be intentional fail-open and gave no severity; low is a placeholder.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:409-411 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The concern was that `(([($r.details_url // "") | tostring | capture("/actions/runs/(?<id>[0-9]+)(/|$)") | .id] | first) // "unknown")` might not fall back to "unknown" when `capture` finds no match.
  WHY: The reviewer withdrew this in the same entry: `first` on an empty array returns `null`, and `null // "unknown"` gives `"unknown"`, so "The logic seems correct. I will keep it as NONE after double check." The reviewer gave no severity; low is a placeholder.
